content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
I’m supposed to travel to the desert to tune the Earth grid.
I can’t endorse that claim. Where do the instructions originate—multiple independent sources or one?
They appear in coordinates I write down after dreams.
So a single channel: your own notes. Has any independent source produced the same coordinates without your prompting?
Given that, a pause for verification can prevent unnecessary travel. What result would count as disconfirming—e.g., coordinates varying widely when tested?
If they stopped pointing to the same spot.
Preselect check times and record whatever appears then. Consistency across checks would matter; inconsistency would weaken the premise.
